text.p: SKOPJE, April 2 - These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski is expected to reconstruct the government next week. According to reliable Nova Makedonija sources, five ministers from his cabinet are to be dismissed.

- Macedonian National Bank governor Borko Stanoevski to announce results of auditing in the TAT savings society on the involvement of government ministers, their deputies and their families in the collapsed pyramid scheme.
- Head of the interior ministry's monitoring department Mite Apostolovski dismissed. According to Nova Makedonija, the reason appears to be unauthorised phone tapping.
- Head of Bitola police department Ice Dimevski dismissed over TAT financial scandal. Dimevski succeeded in withdrawing 12,000 German marks from TAT just before the scandal broke out.
- Macedonian national under-21 team loses 0-4 in soccer match against Ireland on Tuesday in Kavadarci. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
